messages:
jordan: Quick sync — propose prioritization for Optimize features: 1) intelligent batching suggestions, 2) prefix/KV caching controls, 3) quantization recommendation engine, 4) eval-triggered alerts. Need to align on launch criteria and scope for an MVP.

mira: +1. Customers keep asking for caching + batching together. Important that caching is per-route and opt-outable.

sam: For quant recs we need model + seq-length profiles and perf/quality deltas. MVP: rule-based recommendations (thresholds) instead of full auto-tuner.

alex_pm: From PM side: enterprise deals care most about eval-triggered alerts and audit trails. If alerts missing at GA we may lose a few Reserved Capacity deals.

nishant: Implementation note: batching advisor is low-risk — offline analyzer comparing observed latency vs. theoretical. Caching needs KV cache metrics and TTL controls. Quant recs require offline evals and a safe preset system.

jordan: Proposed MVP launch criteria: batching advisor + per-route caching toggle (CLI/Config only, no full console UX), quant recs as downloadable "recommended profile" artifact, alerts as eval-triggered Slack/email notifications with basic ticket creation. Can we cut scope from a full console-driven rollout?

mira: We should define detection SLOs for recommendations — e.g., only recommend batching when expected p95 latency reduction > 10% and no increase in error rate. Also require an explicit acceptance flow.

sam: For quantization recs ship "safe presets" (e.g., int8-safe, int4-cautious) with expected quality delta < 2% on standard evals. That lets us avoid per-customer tuning initially.

alex_pm: Customer asks we need to capture: Acme wants canary alerts tied to prompt sets; BetaBank requires auditable eval history per rollout. So include a minimal eval metadata model (prompt_set_id, model_version, metric_snapshot).

nishant: Alerts integration plan: eval pipeline posts to alerts service. MVP behavior: post to #optimize-ops, send email to owner, create JIRA ticket via webhook. Later: automatic fallback to a safer model variant.

jordan: Tentative timeline: 6 weeks for batching + caching basics, 8–10 weeks to expose quant recs as recommendations, 2–3 weeks to wire eval->alert plumbing. Dependencies: metrics ingestion, eval infra, console hooks for manifests.

mira: Main risks: prompt-set privacy/consent, noisy recs causing mistrust, regressions slipping into production. Mitigations: privacy docs, conservative thresholds, canary rollout by percent.

sam: Blockers: we need customer traces (model, seq length, tokens per request). For MVP we can synthesize traces from public workloads.

alex_pm: Decision proposal: ship batching + caching first as GA, introduce quantization recommendations as opt-in beta, provide eval-triggered alerts to select enterprise customers as canary feature. Are we aligned?

jordan: Agreed. Action items: 1) @nishant draft infra spec and dependency map; 2) @sam build a prototype rule-based quant recommender and baseline; 3) @mira write privacy/consent + acceptance UX doc; 4) @alex_pm finalize beta customer list and outreach plan. I'll convert notes into a short PRD.

deploy-bot: docs/optimize/mvp-checklist.md created by jordan.

mira: I'll prep a 1-pager for Sales & Solutions to set expectations.

nishant: I'll post the infra sketch by EOD Thu and ping infra team for metrics access.

sam: Starting an eval harness today; will share perf baselines in the thread.

alex_pm: Scheduling follow-up sync next Tue 10am — calendar invite incoming.

jordan: Invite sent. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
